purpose: Separate early stopping from M2 extra-target supervision; retain M1 accuracy while improving M2.
loss: Common M1 targets weight 1, M2-only targets weight lambda, invalid targets weight 0. Both power and state BCE sums divided by total target weight. Validation uses unweighted M1 power MAE.
controls: Reuse audited C_M1 seeds 0/1/2 from m2_core_20261010_v1. Compare w100 to old C_M2 to isolate early stopping; compare w050/w025 to w100 to isolate supervision weight. Architecture, seed, input, split, optimizer, state coefficient remain fixed.
analysis: Return validation JSON, best weights and logs. Dense M1/M2/extra, calm, recovery and h1 are scored locally on the frozen validation grid only.

decision.selection: Only candidates passing every gate are eligible; lowest mean dense M2 MAE wins, then M1 MAE, then lower extra weight. Otherwise retain C_M1 and diagnose; do not evaluate test or add confirmation seeds automatically. Report unique-target and event weighting sensitivity for calm and extra samples.
